note: Study analysis vocabulary for the property map (E3); not ontology vocabulary.

classes.label: Glass transition temperature (Tg)
classes.definition: Temperature of the glass transition by any method (DSC onset, midpoint or inflection; DMA tan δ or E'' peak or E' onset; TMA; dielectric), including the Tg of a soft or hard phase. The method is recorded in the method field, not in the class.

classes.label: Melting temperature (Tm)
classes.definition: Melting peak, onset or end temperature of a crystalline phase measured on heating, including phase-specific and multiple melting peaks. Excludes the extrapolated equilibrium melting temperature.

classes.label: Equilibrium melting temperature (Tm0)
classes.definition: Extrapolated equilibrium melting temperature (Hoffman–Weeks or Gibbs–Thomson).

classes.label: Crystallization temperature (Tc)
classes.definition: Peak or onset temperature of crystallization on cooling from the melt.

classes.label: Cold-crystallization temperature (Tcc)
classes.definition: Peak or onset temperature of crystallization on heating from the glass.

classes.label: Melting enthalpy (ΔHm)
classes.definition: Enthalpy (heat) of fusion measured on heating, including net ΔHm − ΔHcc. Excludes the reference enthalpy of a 100% crystalline polymer, which is a calculation parameter.

classes.label: Crystallization enthalpy (ΔHc, ΔHcc)
classes.definition: Enthalpy released by crystallization on cooling or by cold crystallization on heating.

classes.label: Heat capacity and ΔCp at Tg
classes.definition: Specific heat capacity and the heat-capacity step at the glass transition.

classes.label: Crystallization kinetics
classes.definition: Crystallization half-time, Avrami exponent and rate constant, spherulite growth rate, nucleation density and crystallization rate.

classes.label: Other transition or relaxation temperature
classes.definition: Secondary (β, γ) relaxations, liquid-crystalline, order–disorder and hard-domain dissociation temperatures, and DSC exotherm peaks not assigned to crystallization or cure.

classes.label: Heat deflection temperature (HDT)
classes.definition: Heat deflection (distortion) temperature under load (DTUL), at any test stress; the stress is a separate test condition.

classes.label: Softening temperature (Vicat and other)
classes.definition: Vicat softening temperature at any load and other softening points (ring-and-ball, TMA softening).

classes.label: Service temperature
classes.definition: Continuous use or maximum service temperature, relative thermal index (RTI) and continuous heat resistance.

classes.label: Thermal expansion (CTE)
classes.definition: Linear or volumetric coefficient of thermal expansion.

classes.label: Thermal conductivity and diffusivity
classes.definition: Thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity and thermal effusivity.

classes.label: Other thermal property
classes.definition: Other thermal quantities: dependence of Tg on water or composition, changes of a thermal property relative to a reference material (ΔTg, HDT gain), enthalpy relaxation (physical ageing), unassigned DSC enthalpies and thermal-behaviour descriptors.

classes.label: Decomposition onset temperature
classes.definition: Onset or initial temperature of thermal decomposition (Tonset, IDT, Td) from TGA or other methods.

classes.label: Temperature at specified mass loss (Tx%)
classes.definition: Temperature at which a stated fraction of mass is lost in TGA (T1%, T5%, T10%, T50%).

classes.label: Temperature of maximum decomposition rate
classes.definition: Temperature of the DTG peak (Tmax, Tp).

classes.label: Char yield and residual mass
classes.definition: Residue remaining at a stated temperature in TGA or pyrolysis.

classes.label: Mass loss on heating
classes.definition: Mass lost on heating: TGA step mass loss, isothermal mass loss, volatile content released by heating.

classes.label: Decomposition activation energy
classes.definition: Apparent activation energy of thermal or thermo-oxidative decomposition.

classes.label: Oxidation induction time or temperature
classes.definition: Oxidation induction time (OIT) or oxidation onset temperature (OOT).

classes.label: Other thermal decomposition behaviour
classes.definition: Decomposition temperature ranges, pyrolysis products and monomer yield, decomposition mechanism and stage assignments.

classes.label: Tensile strength
classes.definition: Ultimate tensile strength, tensile stress or strength at break and maximum tensile stress; includes fibre tenacity.

classes.label: Tensile yield strength
classes.definition: Tensile yield stress or strength, including offset yield.

classes.label: Tensile (Young's) modulus
classes.definition: Tensile, Young's or elastic modulus from a stress–strain test, including secant and initial modulus; an unqualified Young's or elastic modulus is assigned here.

classes.label: Elongation at break
classes.definition: Elongation or strain at break (ultimate elongation) in tension.

classes.label: Strain at yield
classes.definition: Elongation or strain at the tensile yield point.

classes.label: Stress at specified strain
classes.definition: Tensile stress at a stated elongation (M100, M300, 100% modulus).

classes.label: Tensile toughness
classes.definition: Energy to break or area under the tensile stress–strain curve.

classes.label: Flexural strength
classes.definition: Flexural strength or flexural yield strength.

classes.label: Flexural modulus
classes.definition: Flexural (bending) modulus or stiffness.

classes.label: Flexural strain
classes.definition: Flexural strain at break or failure.

classes.label: Compressive strength
classes.definition: Compressive strength, yield stress or stress at a stated compressive strain.

classes.label: Compressive modulus
classes.definition: Modulus from a compression test.

classes.label: Shear strength and modulus
classes.definition: Bulk shear strength, shear or torsional modulus (not adhesive lap shear).

classes.label: Dynamic storage and loss modulus
classes.definition: Storage and loss moduli of solids from DMA (E', E'', G', G'').

classes.label: Damping (tan δ)
classes.definition: Magnitude of the mechanical loss factor tan δ (the temperature of its peak is a Tg).

classes.label: Creep and stress relaxation
classes.definition: Creep strain or compliance, creep rupture, stress relaxation and their activation energies.

classes.label: Fatigue
classes.definition: Fatigue life, cycles to failure and endurance limit.

classes.label: Poisson's ratio
classes.definition: Poisson's ratio.

classes.label: Other mechanical property
classes.definition: Other mechanical quantities: changes relative to a reference material, burst and puncture strength, cyclic and stress–strain behaviour descriptors, strain-induced crystallization onset, ductility.

classes.label: Notched Izod impact strength
classes.definition: Notched Izod impact strength or resistance (ASTM D256, ISO 180/A).

classes.label: Unnotched Izod impact strength
classes.definition: Unnotched Izod impact strength.

classes.label: Notched Charpy impact strength
classes.definition: Notched Charpy impact strength (ISO 179/1eA).

classes.label: Unnotched Charpy impact strength
classes.definition: Unnotched Charpy impact strength.

classes.label: Other impact strength
classes.definition: Falling-dart, drop, tensile-impact, film-pendulum, Gardner and puncture impact, and impact strength without a stated test geometry.

classes.label: Fracture toughness
classes.definition: Critical stress-intensity factor (KIC), critical energy release rate (GIC), J-integral and essential work of fracture.

classes.label: Tear strength
classes.definition: Tear strength or resistance (Elmendorf, trouser, angle).

classes.label: Brittleness temperature
classes.definition: Low-temperature brittleness or ductile–brittle transition temperature.

classes.label: Shore A hardness
classes.definition: Shore A durometer hardness.

classes.label: Shore D hardness
classes.definition: Shore D durometer hardness.

classes.label: Other hardness
classes.definition: Shore C, 00 and A2, IRHD, Rockwell, Barcol, ball-indentation, pencil, Vickers and nanoindentation hardness, unspecified durometer hardness, and hardness-derived indices.

classes.label: Compression set
classes.definition: Compression set after a stated deformation, time and temperature, and related recovery measures.

classes.label: Volume swell in fluids
classes.definition: Volume or mass change of an elastomer or plastic immersed in oils, fuels or other fluids.

classes.label: Crosslink density and gel content
classes.definition: Crosslink density, molar mass between crosslinks (Mc) and gel (insoluble) fraction.

classes.label: Resilience, hysteresis and recovery
classes.definition: Rebound resilience, hysteresis energy loss, elastic recovery, shape recovery, tension and permanent set, stress softening.

classes.label: Melt flow rate (MFR/MVR)
classes.definition: Melt mass- or volume-flow rate (melt flow index) at a stated temperature and load.

classes.label: Melt viscosity
classes.definition: Apparent, complex or zero-shear viscosity of a polymer melt.

classes.label: Other melt rheology
classes.definition: Flow activation energy, relaxation times, power-law and Carreau parameters, melt strength, die swell and crossover points.

classes.label: Cure kinetics and reaction enthalpy
classes.definition: Apparent activation energy, reaction order, rate constants, kinetic model parameters, reaction enthalpy and degree of cure of a curing or crosslinking reaction.

classes.label: Cure and gel times
classes.definition: Gel time, optimum cure time (t90), scorch time, rheometer torque, cure-rate index and pot life.

classes.label: Processability
classes.definition: Drawability (maximum draw ratio), spinnability, processing window and printability of the material.

classes.label: Oxygen permeability
classes.definition: Thickness-normalized oxygen permeability coefficient (Barrer, cm³·mm/(m²·day·atm), mol·m/(m²·s·Pa)).

classes.label: Oxygen transmission rate (OTR)
classes.definition: Oxygen transmission rate of a film of stated thickness, not normalized for thickness.

classes.label: Water vapour permeability (WVP)
classes.definition: Thickness-normalized water-vapour permeability or permeability coefficient.

classes.label: Water vapour transmission rate (WVTR)
classes.definition: Water-vapour transmission rate of a film of stated thickness, including thickness-normalized WVTR reported under that name.

classes.label: CO2 permeability
classes.definition: CO2 permeability coefficient, permeance or transmission rate.

classes.label: Other gas and vapour permeability
classes.definition: Permeability, permeance or transmission of N2, He, H2, Ar, CH4, methanol, organic vapours and unspecified gases.

classes.label: Permselectivity
classes.definition: Ideal or mixed-gas selectivity.

classes.label: Diffusion coefficient
classes.definition: Diffusion coefficient of water, gases or solvents in the polymer.

classes.label: Sorption and solubility coefficient
classes.definition: Solubility (sorption) coefficient of a penetrant in the polymer and sorption-isotherm parameters (Langmuir, BET or GAB monolayer capacity, clustering).

classes.label: Water absorption by immersion
classes.definition: Water absorption or uptake by immersion (24 h, saturation, equilibrium), including absorption rate and saturation time.

classes.label: Moisture content and sorption
classes.definition: Equilibrium moisture content, moisture regain and moisture absorption from humid air, and water content of the material.

classes.label: Swelling ratio in water or solvents
classes.definition: Equilibrium swelling ratio or degree of swelling of gels, networks and membranes in water or solvents.

classes.label: Membrane separation performance
classes.definition: Pure-water flux, rejection and bubble-point pressure of membranes.

classes.label: Other barrier or transport property
classes.definition: Permeation and diffusion activation energies, hydrogen retention, water-retention value, barrier improvement factors and other changes in barrier properties relative to a reference.

classes.label: Light transmittance
classes.definition: Total, luminous or spectral light transmittance and transparency.

classes.label: Haze and opacity
classes.definition: Haze, clarity and opacity.

classes.label: Refractive index and birefringence
classes.definition: Refractive index, Abbe number and birefringence.

classes.label: Colour and yellowness
classes.definition: Yellowness index, colour coordinates and whiteness.

classes.label: Gloss
classes.definition: Specular gloss.

classes.label: Optical absorption and emission
classes.definition: Absorbance, absorption coefficient, absorption or emission peak, optical band gap, UV cut-off and luminescence.

classes.label: Other optical property
classes.definition: Other optical quantities.

classes.label: Dielectric constant
classes.definition: Relative permittivity (dielectric constant).

classes.label: Dielectric loss tangent
classes.definition: Dielectric loss tangent or dissipation factor.

classes.label: Dielectric strength
classes.definition: Dielectric breakdown strength and arc or tracking resistance.

classes.label: Electrical conductivity
classes.definition: Electronic conductivity of the material (S/cm).

classes.label: Electrical resistivity
classes.definition: Volume or surface resistivity, sheet and contact resistance.

classes.label: Ionic and proton conductivity
classes.definition: Ionic or proton conductivity.

classes.label: Piezoelectric and ferroelectric
classes.definition: Piezoelectric coefficients (d33), remanent polarization, coercive field and Curie temperature.

classes.label: Thermoelectric
classes.definition: Seebeck coefficient, power factor and figure of merit.

classes.label: Electrochemical
classes.definition: Electrochemical capacity, redox potentials and electrochemical stability window.

classes.label: Electronic structure and charge transport
classes.definition: HOMO and LUMO levels, work function and charge-carrier mobility.

classes.label: Other electrical property
classes.definition: Other electrical quantities (annealing effects on conductivity, raw dielectric resonance data).

classes.label: Degree of crystallinity
classes.definition: Crystalline fraction by DSC, WAXD/XRD, FTIR or density; includes relative crystallinity.

classes.label: Crystal form and phase content
classes.definition: Crystal form or polymorph, unit-cell parameters and phase fractions (for example PVDF β or electroactive fraction).

classes.label: Crystallite and lamellar dimensions
classes.definition: Crystallite size, lamellar thickness, long period and spherulite size.

classes.label: Orientation
classes.definition: Molecular or crystal orientation (Hermans orientation factor, orientation index).

classes.label: Phase morphology
classes.definition: Phase separation, domain size, dispersed-phase size and microphase structure.

classes.label: Porosity and pore size
classes.definition: Porosity, pore size and specific surface area.

classes.label: Particle and fibre size
classes.definition: Size of the material's own particles, powder or fibres (fibre diameter, linear density, bead size).

classes.label: Other morphology
classes.definition: Surface and cross-section morphology descriptors, changes in crystallinity, scattering correlation lengths and other structural observations.

classes.label: Weight-average molecular weight (Mw)
classes.definition: Weight-average molar mass by GPC/SEC, light scattering or other methods.

classes.label: Number-average molecular weight (Mn)
classes.definition: Number-average molar mass by GPC/SEC, NMR end-group analysis or osmometry.

classes.label: Other molar mass
classes.definition: Viscosity-average, Z-average, peak and nominal or unspecified molecular weight, and degree of polymerization.

classes.label: Dispersity (Đ)
classes.definition: Dispersity (polydispersity index, Mw/Mn).

classes.label: Intrinsic viscosity and viscosity number
classes.definition: Intrinsic viscosity, inherent or reduced viscosity, viscosity number and K-value used as molar-mass indices.

classes.label: Copolymer and segment composition
classes.definition: Comonomer or segment content of the polymer itself (vinyl acetate, ethylene, acrylonitrile, styrene, HV, hard segment, chlorine content).

classes.label: Degree of substitution and functionalization
classes.definition: Degree of substitution or molar substitution, acetyl and alkoxyl content, degree of deacetylation, hydrolysis, sulfonation or neutralization.

classes.label: Chain microstructure
classes.definition: Tacticity (diad, triad, pentad), regio- and stereo-defects, cis/trans content, branching and sequence distribution.

classes.label: Functional-group and end-group content
classes.definition: Ion-exchange capacity, equivalent weight, hydroxyl number, epoxy equivalent, end-group and acid content.

classes.label: Residual monomer and impurities
classes.definition: Residual monomer, oligomer, catalyst residue, ash and extractable content.

classes.label: Spectroscopic signature
classes.definition: IR or Raman band positions and intensities, NMR shifts and XPS features used to characterize the polymer.

classes.label: Other chemical structure
classes.definition: Repeat-unit identity, chain architecture and other chemical-structure descriptors.

classes.label: Solution viscosity
classes.definition: Dynamic or kinematic viscosity of a polymer solution or dispersion at a stated concentration (for example cellulose-ether grade viscosity).

classes.label: Cloud point and LCST
classes.definition: Cloud point, lower or upper critical solution temperature and solution phase-transition temperature.

classes.label: Thermal gelation temperature
classes.definition: Sol–gel or thermal gelation temperature of a polymer solution.

classes.label: Solubility and dissolution
classes.definition: Solubility in solvents or water (qualitative or quantitative), film water solubility and dissolution time.

classes.label: Solution thermodynamics and chain dimensions
classes.definition: Flory–Huggins χ, Huggins constant, second virial coefficient, solubility parameters and chain dimensions in solution.

classes.label: Other solution property
classes.definition: Other solution quantities, including dependences of the cloud point on concentration, heating rate or salt and salt-induced volume transitions.

classes.label: Hydrolytic degradation
classes.definition: Mass loss, rate or half-life of hydrolysis in water or buffer.

classes.label: Biodegradation and disintegration
classes.definition: Biodegradation by CO2 evolution or oxygen demand, mineralization, compost or soil-burial mass loss and disintegration.

classes.label: Enzymatic degradation
classes.definition: Rate or extent of enzyme-catalysed degradation.

classes.label: Property retention after ageing or exposure
classes.definition: Retention or change of a property after thermal, UV, fluid, water or other ageing exposure.

classes.label: Weathering and oxidation
classes.definition: Carbonyl index, photo- and thermo-oxidation indicators and UV stability.

classes.label: Chemical and stress-crack resistance
classes.definition: Resistance to chemicals and solvents and environmental stress-crack resistance.

classes.label: Molar-mass loss on degradation
classes.definition: Decrease or retention of molar mass or solution viscosity during degradation.

classes.label: Emissions and migration
classes.definition: Emission of formaldehyde and volatiles, migration, plasticizer exudation and fogging.

classes.label: Other degradation
classes.definition: Generic mass loss in degradation tests, degradation mechanism and other degradation quantities.

classes.label: Density
classes.definition: Density, specific gravity, bulk density and specific volume.

classes.label: Shrinkage
classes.definition: Mould shrinkage, cure shrinkage and thermal shrinkage of films or fibres.

classes.label: Dimensional change with water or humidity
classes.definition: Thickness swelling, length or cross-section change on water or humidity exposure.

classes.label: Free volume
classes.definition: Fractional free volume and free-volume hole size.

classes.label: Flammability
classes.definition: Limiting oxygen index, UL 94 rating, heat release, burning rate and combustion behaviour.

classes.label: Contact angle and surface energy
classes.definition: Water or liquid contact angle and surface free energy.

classes.label: Adhesion and bond strength
classes.definition: Lap-shear, peel, pull-off and other adhesive or interfacial bond strength.

classes.label: Friction and wear
classes.definition: Coefficient of friction and wear rate.

classes.label: Surface roughness
classes.definition: Surface roughness (Ra, Rq).

classes.label: Other surface property
classes.definition: Other surface and interfacial quantities (monolayer isotherms, surface pressure).

classes.label: Biological response
classes.definition: Cytotoxicity, cell viability, antimicrobial activity, protein adsorption and biocompatibility.

classes.label: Other material property
classes.definition: A material property that fits no other class.

classes.label: Heating or cooling rate
classes.definition: Heating, cooling or scan rate in a thermal measurement (DSC, TGA, DMA, HDT, Vicat).

classes.label: Thermal-analysis temperature program
classes.definition: Temperature range, endpoints, hold times, cycles, modulation and the heating run evaluated in DSC, TGA or DMA.

classes.label: Test temperature
classes.definition: Temperature at which a property was measured.

classes.label: Test relative humidity
classes.definition: Relative humidity during a measurement.

classes.label: Test atmosphere and purge gas
classes.definition: Atmosphere and purge-gas identity, purity and flow rate during a measurement.

classes.label: Test speed or strain rate
classes.definition: Crosshead speed, displacement, strain, extension or loading rate in a mechanical test.

classes.label: Frequency, amplitude and shear rate
classes.definition: Frequency, strain or displacement amplitude and shear rate in dynamic mechanical, rheological or dielectric tests.

classes.label: Applied load, stress or strain
classes.definition: Load, stress, strain, pressure or energy applied in a test (HDT stress, MFR load, compression-set strain, pendulum energy).

classes.label: Test-fixture geometry
classes.definition: Support span, grip or clamp separation, plate diameter and gap, exposed area and die dimensions of the test fixture.

classes.label: Exposure or ageing environment
classes.definition: Medium, temperature, pH, concentration, humidity or dose of a degradation, immersion or ageing exposure.

classes.label: Test or exposure duration
classes.definition: Duration of a test, immersion, ageing, incubation or hold.

classes.label: Replicate count
classes.definition: Number of replicates, specimens or measurements.

classes.label: Measurement solution
classes.definition: Polymer concentration and solvent of a solution used for a measurement.

classes.label: Other test parameter
classes.definition: Other measurement settings and controls (electrical current, blank or control loadings, sampling and weighing intervals, cycle counts of a test protocol).

classes.label: Specimen thickness
classes.definition: Thickness of the specimen, film, sheet, membrane or coating tested.

classes.label: Specimen dimensions and geometry
classes.definition: Specimen dimensions, gauge length, shape, type and notch geometry.

classes.label: Specimen mass
classes.definition: Mass of the specimen used in a measurement.

classes.label: Specimen form and preparation route
classes.definition: How the specimen was made or obtained and its form.

classes.label: Drying
classes.definition: Drying temperature, duration and atmosphere before processing or testing.

classes.label: Conditioning
classes.definition: Pre-test conditioning temperature, relative humidity and duration.

classes.label: Annealing and thermal history
classes.definition: Annealing, heat setting, quenching, isothermal crystallization and erasure of thermal history in specimen preparation.

classes.label: Melt processing conditions
classes.definition: Temperatures, pressures, speeds and durations of moulding, extrusion, compounding, pressing, calendering and printing.

classes.label: Solution processing conditions
classes.definition: Casting, coating, electrospinning and coagulation conditions, including casting-solution concentration and solvent.

classes.label: Cure schedule
classes.definition: Cure, post-cure and vulcanization temperature, duration and pressure.

classes.label: Drawing and stretching
classes.definition: Draw or stretch ratio and drawing temperature and speed applied in preparation.

classes.label: Synthesis conditions
classes.definition: Polymerization or modification method, temperature, time and feed.

classes.label: Post-treatment
classes.definition: Irradiation, plasma, sterilization, doping and other treatments applied after forming.

classes.label: Other preparation detail
classes.definition: Other preparation details.

classes.label: Instrument and equipment
classes.definition: Instrument model, accessories, load cell, pans and crucibles, calibration standards.

classes.label: Test method or standard
classes.definition: Test standard (ASTM, ISO, DIN, JIS, GB/T), measurement technique, protocol and test mode (for example DMA dual cantilever, DSC Tzero).

classes.label: Analysis criterion or calculation parameter
classes.definition: How a value was extracted, calculated or qualified: assignment criteria, definitions, fitting ranges, reference values and constants used in a calculation (reference enthalpy of fusion, solvent molar volume), reported uncertainties and other statistics.

classes.label: Filler and reinforcement
classes.definition: Content, identity and size of fillers and reinforcements (carbon black, silica, glass or carbon fibre, clay, nanoparticles).

classes.label: Plasticizer and oil
classes.definition: Content and identity of plasticizers, extender and process oils.

classes.label: Cure system
classes.definition: Content and identity of curatives, hardeners, accelerators, activators, initiators, catalysts and crosslinkers.

classes.label: Other additive
classes.definition: Antioxidants, stabilizers, flame retardants, compatibilizers, nucleating agents, pigments and other additives.

classes.label: Blend or formulation composition
classes.definition: Ratio or content of polymers and components in a blend, compound, composite or formulation.

classes.label: Other formulation detail
classes.definition: Other composition details.

classes.label: Material grade and identity
classes.definition: Grade, trade name, supplier or identity of the material tested.

classes.label: Observation or interpretation
classes.definition: Qualitative observation, comparison between methods, or proposed mechanism that is not a measurable property.

classes.label: Unclassified
classes.definition: Property string that could not be assigned; here only the empty string (no property recorded).
